answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the grove of a task receipt, and the glacier is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
